findings.detail: Object-shaped Codex thread statuses were not parsed.
Child goal/result/token events and root lifecycle routing could pollute or overwrite root state.
Turn completion was conflated with terminal thread completion.
Thread result payloads were not parsed.
Targeted operations did not enforce capability, lifecycle, runtime, or approval state.
Direct child turns forced approvalPolicy never and lacked child-correlated approval handling.
Busy-parent wait/close could reject or race without steer fallback.
Activity updates replaced rather than accumulated history.
Provider thread IDs were not bounded or sanitized before routing/persistence.
Child attachments omitted WSL path translation.
Delayed events could regress completed state without monotonic ordering guards.
Pagination lacked cursor-loop, page, and child-count bounds.
Unknown parent relationships were flattened to root.
Collaboration tool metadata and consolidation linkage were incomplete.
Real status, pagination, denial, approval, busy-parent, result, bounds, activity, stale capability, and WSL cases lacked coverage.
